high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from a chess puzzle game. The interface indicates that it is part of a series of daily puzzles, specifically labeled as "DAILY PUZZLES" at the top. The specific puzzle being shown is titled "MATE IN 1 MOVE - BLACK TO MOVE," which means the player must find a move that will checkmate the white king in one move. The chessboard is displayed with standard black and white squares, and the pieces are arranged according to the current position of the game. The board shows the following pieces: Two black rooks on the first rank. A black queen on the second rank
